message: Well, I'm glad I've read all your comments on T-netix. My boyfriend is up in Hagerstown, MD. He had told me that I could set up an account with T-Netix to try and save on the costs of talking with him. Collect calls are outrageous. He had gotten a pre-paid card but when it runs out it sucks having to wait till the money orders that are sent to him get into his account and then he has to fill out a form to put money on his phone account. So, in my search for this company I came across your posts and I'm glad I did and did not get subjected to this madness that you all have gone through. I'm sorry for that inmate's families that have to deal with this bullshit on top of everything else. If anyone has any information on a cheaper way to communicate with someone on the inside that would be greatly appreciated. Thank you.
